title: Jynx & Stitches: The Great Revenge #1
desc: When five aspiring assistants arrive at the secluded estate of the legendary magician Lucian, they believe they’ve been invited to audition for the performance of a lifetime. But something is hunting them in the dark halls of the mansion—a grotesque clown stitched together from the dead. As friends vanish one by one, the survivors uncover a century-old curse and the monstrous truth behind Lucian’s magic. Now trapped between a sadistic immortal warlock and the patchwork horror sent to destroy him, one woman must survive a night where every act ends in blood. Because in this house… the show never ends.
